warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.desc: Front-line fighter. Best weapons and armor.

mage.name: Mage
mage.desc: Wielder of mage spells, HALITO to TILTOWAIT. Fragile.

priest.name: Priest
priest.desc: Channel of priest spells, DIOS to KADORTO. Maces and medium armor.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.desc: Master of traps, locks, and the hidden knife. Best chest work.

spellblade.name: Spellblade
spellblade.desc: Warrior who bends mage spells (levels 1-4) to the blade. Slow learner.

templar.name: Templar
templar.desc: Holy warrior with priest spells (levels 1-4) and healing hands. Light only.

sage.name: Sage
sage.desc: Student of both schools, learned slowly. Master identifier of items.

shadowdancer.name: Shadowdancer
shadowdancer.desc: Elite killer who strikes from hiding for instant death. Shadow only.
